args: set -a; . ./infrastructure/project.env; set +a; [ -n "$SERVER_BRIDGE_PORT" ] || { echo 'mc MCP: SERVER_BRIDGE_PORT not set in infrastructure/project.env' >&2; exit 1; }; [ -n "$PEXP_MCPFABRIC_DIR" ] || { echo 'mc MCP: PEXP_MCPFABRIC_DIR not set (path to your MCPFabric checkout)' >&2; exit 1; }; NODE=$(command -v node || ls -1d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node | sort -V | tail -1); export MCPFABRIC_TOKEN="$(cat infrastructure/.state/mcpfabric-token 2>/dev/null)"; export MCPFABRIC_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$SERVER_BRIDGE_PORT"; exec "$NODE" "$PEXP_MCPFABRIC_DIR/mcp-server/dist/index.js"
